name: AI Voice Applications (Conversational IVR Bots)
author: AiPBX Official Team
description: Build voice-driven AI IVR applications that greet callers, transcribe speech via Cloud/OpenAI-compatible STT, query external HTTP webhooks, and route calls dynamically.

description_i18n.tr: Arayanları sesli karşılayan, konuşmayı metne çevirip dış webhook/CRM sorgusu yapan ve çağrıyı dinamik yönlendiren AI sesli botlar oluşturur.
description_i18n.en: Build voice-driven AI IVR applications that greet callers, transcribe speech via Cloud/OpenAI-compatible STT, query external HTTP webhooks, and route calls dynamically.
